findings.description: I-1: Repair damaged split and sagging roof purlin in mezzanine by sistering or replacing
I-2: Clean surface mold on underside of roof deck with acceptable solvent
I-3: Replace damaged/cracked skylights temporarily sealed with vinyl tape (four at $750 each)
I-4: Engage electrical contractor to map out electrical service and distribution
I-5: Service office heat pump icing over due to low refrigerant
I-6: Engage plumbing/septic firm to evaluate septic system condition and capacity; consider connecting to sanitary line in St. Michaels Road
I-7: Determine actual size of water service for possible future sprinklering (No Cost)
I-8: Verify existence of rear right-of-way to adjacent property to the north (No Cost)
RR-1: Allowance for maintenance and re-striping of bituminous paving, $5,000 each in Years 5 and 10
RR-2: Allowance to replace skylights as they fail, two per year in Years 3, 6 and 9 at $750 per skylight
RR-3: Replace shingled surface over low-sloped roof area, approx 4,550 SF at $5.00/SF
Re-point/seal and monitor minor step cracking in west wall of latest addition
Trim or remove tree overhanging south front of building
Mezzanine requires reconfiguration or elimination to meet current code access/egress
Provide one van accessible parking space and striped crosswalk to building
Septic system to be tested/evaluated prior to re-tasking or subdividing building
Locate/verify electrical meters (assumed two, possibly one)
Heat pumps expected to require replacement over term based on age; consider replacing office heat pump
